main.description: Run Murakumo Vision (qwen3-vl-8b) over the curated Mapillary images for a tile, extracting visible entities (Building, Storefront, Sign, Vehicle, Person...) plus OCR text. Emits one VisionResult per detected entity with bbox, label, confidence, and OCR. Re-uses the maps `analyze_image` / `vision_import_entities` pipeline (`60-apps/etzhayyim-project-maps/CLAUDE.md` §Vision Intelligence). Output is consumed by `linkActor` to bind detected entities to legal-entity DIDs.

imageRefs.description: Mapillary image URLs (or B2 URIs of cached copies).

minConfidence.description: Drop detections below this confidence. Default 0.55.

kindAllowlist.description: Restrict to these entity kinds. Empty = all.

kind.description: Building | Storefront | Sign | Vehicle | Person | Spot | Place | ...

ocr.description: Concatenated OCR text within the bbox.
